label: Timed dialogue interrupt
prerequisites: Record executable hash, game version, DLC list and settings from the actual installation.
Use a protected private profile and preparation receipt; confirm selected-save identity through normal Load Game.
Establish a native baseline with the same prepared save before accepting VR behavior.
acquisitionTasks: Preferred earlier-progression lead: Freedom's Progress Veetor conversation in BioD_ProFre_501Veetor_LOC_INT, inspected in both base and DLC_METR_Patch01. It has explicit Paragon and Renegade interrupt branches and a nearby authored normal autosave route. Reuse the separate normal new-game playthrough proposed for the ProCer reload fixture; verify actual save placement and branch reachability. See research/le2-interrupt-acquisition.md. Authored track times are not runtime assertions.

Alternative Renegade lead: Garrus recruitment mechanic in BioD_OmgGrA_112Hangar_LOC_INT. Its authored 5.429/7.4299107 second keys are not measured legal input bounds. Existing late-game saves have mechanic outcome 2660 set; Liara/Citadel alternatives also have unresolved or completed prerequisites. No current late-game pre-interrupt fixture is established; do not reset isolated story flags. See research/le2-fixture-acquisition.md and research/le2-interrupt-acquisition.md.
Acquire naturally obtained saves immediately before known Paragon and Renegade interrupt opportunities; record conversation, speaker, prompt and expected branch using ordinary native play.

Compare saves before and after the chosen branch, inspect native conversation/condition dependencies with LegendaryExplorer, and document verified plot IDs and journal/streaming prerequisites privately.
Pin base and recipe per variant; use no-op preparation for natural fixtures when no edit is required. Missing plot semantics must remain unresolved rather than forcing a single completion flag.
Define normalized state.dialogue and branch outcome observations with provenance, including legal window opening/closing and input timestamps; current declarations do not establish instrumentation.
loadProcedure: Acquire exclusive native-session ownership and use the protected session workflow.
Prepare a private fixture from the pinned base and recipe; retain the save-tool receipt and constrained semantic diff.
Select the staged save through ordinary Load Game; record the selected entry and loading sequence.
Capture observed start state and rendered scene; compare map, player, resources and relevant plot state with expectedStart checks. A map name alone is insufficient.
resetProcedure: Exit the game and collect run-specific logs, observed state, captures and any resulting saves.
Run protected restoration and retain the restoration receipt including newly created files.
For each variant start again from its immutable base and pinned recipe; never reuse a mutated previous run save.

actions.description: Reach the conversation through ordinary interaction; record camera/UI transition and choices before the interrupt.
For the selected variant press the actual mapped controller response within the legal Paragon/Renegade window, before it, or intentionally after/miss it.
Observe the selected outcome; continue the conversation and return to gameplay. Test that held/released interrupt input does not fire a weapon or select an unintended response.
Complete enough ordinary progression to save, reload normally, and verify the chosen branch persists.

assertions.description: Review normal load entry and actual rendered scene, player state and scenario prerequisites against the private fixture acquisition record.
Both eye captures show readable UI and consistent depth; review alongside controller actions and scene video.
Physical headset reviewer records standing and seated reach, visibility, tracking recovery and comfort for this variant.
Verify the protected-session restoration receipt and session log identify restored profiles, config and saves with no unexplained differences.
Timestamped prompt visibility, window state and native input establish acceptance only inside the legal window and the correct taken/missed branch. Early/late input must not take the branch.

Actual controller response reaches the intended interrupt, prompt remains usable in headset, and context exit produces no combat input leakage or stuck pause. Record the matched native baseline run/hash and deliberate gameplay differences.
Ordinary save/reload preserves the validated branch and subsequent dialogue/progression; compare relevant verified state and rendered continuation.
